name: Nishikawa (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Nishikawa town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing two upswept wing-like strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Nishikawa, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 June 1959.

features.role: Nishikawa town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing two upswept wing-like strokes
